note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Only the supplied relationships are drawn; plain relations have no arrowheads and the return itself is a supplied sequence link captioned 'as configured (illustrative)'. The return point and route are supplied; the renewed examination's sheet stays blank (not shown, no outcome). Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, elements, relationships, focusElement, relationLabels and traversalOrder are editable.
